anomalies.description: A black semi-truck collides with a white semi-truck on a highway, causing the black truck to jackknife, spin, and shed debris; the collision and aftermath are visible across multiple frames.

A semi-truck with a flatbed trailer is involved in a collision on a highway; the truck is jackknifed, emitting smoke and debris, with visible damage to the trailer and undercarriage. The vehicle appears to be sliding or spinning out of control across lanes.; At a nighttime railway crossing, a dark vehicle approaches at speed and collides with the lowered barrier arm; the impact causes the barrier to bend and the vehicle to veer sharply left before coming to rest near the crossing gatehouse.
A blue truck collides with a dark sedan at a railroad crossing, causing the truck to jackknife and overturn onto its side, with visible debris and dust cloud.

A truck loses control, veers off the road onto the right shoulder, and impacts the guardrail or embankment, causing immediate debris scattering and dust cloud; the trailer begins to tilt and separate.

The aftermath of the crash and explosion: the truck is severely damaged, overturned on the roadside, with sustained fire, thick black smoke, and scattered cargo (appearing as small round objects, possibly fruit or produce) across the lanes.

A sudden, intense bright pink/white flash erupts from the wreckage of the truck, accompanied by rapid expansion of gas and debris—characteristic of a high-energy explosion (likely fuel or cargo ignition).; A violent explosion occurs at the truck, producing a bright pink-white flash and a rapidly expanding fireball with dense black smoke rising immediately afterward.

A large truck is involved in a catastrophic crash: it overturns onto its side on the road shoulder, ruptures, and catches fire; debris (including numerous red spherical objects, likely apples) is scattered across the roadway and shoulder throughout the sequence.

A yellow truck overtakes on the left and collides with the rear-left side of the lead dark truck, causing the lead truck to swerve sharply right and lose control.; A large truck (left) collides with the rear of another truck ahead on a snowy road, causing the left truck to jackknife, spin, and sustain severe front-end damage; debris scatters across the road.; A severe multi-vehicle collision involving at least two trucks on a snow-covered road; the white MAN truck is heavily damaged and stationary, with debris scattered and a red dump truck moving away from the impact zone.

A semi-truck has overturned on the right shoulder of a wet, snowy highway; its trailer lies on its side across the lane boundary, with another truck stopped ahead. The scene is static across frames f0–f5, indicating the accident occurred prior to this segment and remains unresolved.; A sedan in the right lane swerves sharply leftward (frames f6–f10), then corrects and drifts back right (f11–f15), crossing lane markings multiple times—indicating loss of control or evasive maneuvering, possibly related to road conditions or preceding incident. No collision is visible, but the erratic motion constitutes a near-miss or incipient accident event.
